decisions.subject: source evidence access
decisions.request: Provide an ephemeral read-only identity restricted to the two Barman server prefixes and the Workspace Context artifact bucket for ListObjects/HEAD metadata only, or sanitized Barman archive/WAL-gap output.
decisions.cost: no source mutation; no payload export

decisions.subject: target artifact storage
decisions.request: Choose a distinct target-owned S3 bucket at an approved existing provider, or provision a dedicated >=100Gi NFS/export; prove retention, off-node backup, and restoreability before GitOps resources are created.
decisions.cost: external bucket/export provisioning may incur cost; approval required before paid provisioning

decisions.subject: target identity and encryption
decisions.request: Approve narrow target Authentik mapping for Rickebo, repair the target-only secret/RBAC path, and use fresh target Data Protection/backend/runtime/MCP/gateway credentials by default; preserving source-wrapped state requires separate explicit approval.
decisions.cost: target-only secret provisioning; no source invalidation

decisions.subject: retained historical PVCs
decisions.request: Keep the two ownerless retained llm-proxy PVCs untouched and outside the clone until provenance/backup evidence exists; any cleanup is a separate authorized task.

safe_boundary: Until D-001 through D-003 are resolved, remain at spec; do not create clone resources or revive historical LLM Proxy branches.
